description: D2: the Stormcaller's drowned bronze and copper beaten again at Last Hearth's forge once he has fallen - ribbed bronze over the shoulders, the chest, the forearms and the shins, a crown of forked tines, the Lodestone. It keeps the storm off the giant who wears it: the shock that runs through water takes less of him, and he wades as if the water were shallower.

bonuses.name: Grounded
bonuses.text: The storm's shock through water takes 30% less of you

bonuses.name: The Bell-warden's Stride
bonuses.text: The shock takes a further 40% less of you, and the water slows you half as much: you stand in the storm as he stood in it
